[ASSISTANT_SAID] Companion planting can benefit plants by repelling pests, attracting beneficial insects, or improving soil health.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended companion plant combinations include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Marigold and Tomatoes: Marigold repels nematodes and attracts beneficial insects.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Basil and Tomatoes: Basil repels pests and adds flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Nasturtium and Cabbage: Nasturtium repels aphids and whiteflies.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Radish and Cucumbers: Radish repels cucumber beetles and helps break up soil.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Borage and Strawberries: Borage attracts pollinators and improves flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Chives and Roses: Chives repel aphids and add nutrients.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Dill and Cucumbers: Dill repels pests and improves growth.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Calendula and Vegetables: Calendula repels various vegetable pests.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Oregano and Peppers: Oregano repels pests and adds flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Comfrey and Vegetables: Comfrey adds nutrients to the soil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When choosing companion plants, consider growing conditions and space requirements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User has been noticing their plants dropping leaves and looking wilted during dry winter months.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User has been using a makeshift humidifier but is considering investing in a proper one.
